title: Permission chaos injector and rollback validation for RBAC v2 regression
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: Add a deterministic 'permission chaos injector' to the RBAC v2 regression harness that (1) mutates permission assignments and role bindings across the golden fixture matrix, (2) simulates audit-log gaps and timestamp skew, and (3) validates that rollback and reconciliation flows restore a consistent, auditable state. This ticket covers implementation of the injector, telemetry hooks for anomaly detection, and CI integration so the chaos-run becomes a gated check for regressions to authorization logic.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Injector can apply three deterministic mutation classes (role-add, role-remove, membership-flip) across golden fixtures and produce a reproducible seed. 2) The regression suite detects the injected drift via golden-state assertions and flags high-severity discrepancies. 3) Automated rollback workflow restores previous permission state and emits a full audit trail; post-rollback assertions confirm parity with pre-injection golden snapshot. 4) Telemetry exposes metrics for mutation rate, rollback success, and audit-log continuity; alerts trigger when rollback fails or audit gaps exceed threshold.
test_plan:
- Implement chaos injector as a standalone binary and a test harness plugin.
- Add deterministic RNG seed parameter and three mutation modes.
- Wire in a 'dry-run' mode to preview changes without mutating prod-like fixtures.
- Run full golden-fixtures matrix under the injector in staging; collect diffs and audit events.
- Execute rollback flow (via state snapshot restore or corrective API calls) and run golden assertions.
- Validate telemetry emitted to Datadog (permission.drift.count, rollback.success.rate, audit.gap.ms).
- Add a CI job that runs a subset of chaos scenarios on every RBAC-related PR and a nightly full-run for coverage.
implementation_notes:
- Use existing fixture serializer to snapshot golden state before mutation.
- Leverage the perm-replay library to apply and then reverse mutations; if reversal fails, capture rollback diff and escalate.
- To simulate audit gaps, the injector will drop or delay some audit events and inject timestamp skews up to 5s; keep skew deterministic per-seed.
- Avoid touching production data: run only against staging / synthetic fixture clusters.
- Telemetry: add tags (seed, mutation_class, fixture_id) to all metrics and traces.
risks_and_mitigations:
- Risk: Injector accidentally applied against a live environment. Mitigation: require explicit --env and a safety token; CI only uses staging.
- Risk: Non-deterministic failures due to concurrency. Mitigation: run with single-writer lock and deterministic ordering per fixture.
- Risk: False positives from stale golden fixtures. Mitigation: add fixture freshness check and one-click fixture refresh workflow guarded by approvals.
